mechanism_narrative: The current level of FEDFUNDS (0.16%) is below the historical threshold of 0.5%, indicating an extremely accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates and drives positive equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE above 7.0% signals a labor market crisis that increases risk aversion and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is above 7.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising FEDFUNDS and rising CPIAUCSL (indicating a tightening monetary policy amid inflation) compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is above 0.5% and CPIAUCSL is above 210.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by HOUST > 600 and RSAFS > 300000), the economy is overheating, leading to a higher probability of a policy-induced recession and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 600 and RSAFS > 300000.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL above 215.0 indicates persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL is above 215.0.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising INDPRO (supply) and falling RSAFS (demand) indicates a supply shock that reduces corporate profitability and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO and RSAFS does not produce negative returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO is above 105.0 and RSAFS is below 350000.
